name: Deerfield River Enhancement Fund
summary: Hydro-mitigation fund for projects in the Deerfield River watershed in Vermont and Massachusetts, covering watershed conservation, stewardship and low-impact access facilities.

geography.label: Deerfield River Basin, Vermont and Massachusetts

amount.note: Applications for any amount up to the roughly $60,000 available this round

fiscal_sponsor.note: Needed by groups outside the types it pays

eligibility.rule: Be a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, educational institution, or local/regional government unit, or use a fiscal sponsor
Locate the project in the Deerfield River Basin or a partly included town, with a direct basin tie in the latter case
Project has clear public benefit and enhances low-impact recreation, education or protection in the watershed
Complete the project within three years at most

documents: Profit/loss statement and balance sheet for the most recently completed fiscal year
Fiscal Sponsor Agreement Form, if applicable
Map with latitude/longitude points, if the project has a site-specific location

status.quote: Applications will be accepted between November 10, 2026 and January 19th, 2027.

opens.quote: Applications for funding open on November 10, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications will be accepted between November 10, 2026 and January 19th, 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible grant recipients include nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, and units of local and regional government within Vermont and Massachusetts.

geography.quote: Projects must be located within the Deerfield River Basin or in towns with some portion falling within the basin.

amount.quote: Applications for any amount up to $60,000 are encouraged.

co_finance_required.quote: While matching funds are not required, applicants are encouraged to demonstrate at least a 50% match in their proposals whenever possible.

access.quote: All applications must be submitted electronically.

window.quote: The Deerfield River Enhancement Fund runs a competitive process every 4 years.

fiscal_sponsor.quote: Deerfield River Enhancement grants must be paid to registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, or units of local and regional government within Vermont and Massachusetts. If your organization or group does not fall into one of these categories, you will need to use a fiscal sponsor.

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted by January 19, 2027, at 5 p.m.

eligibility.quote: Deerfield River Enhancement grants must be paid to registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, or units of local and regional government within Vermont and Massachusetts. If your organization or group does not fall into one of these categories, you will need to use a fiscal sponsor.

Projects must be located within the Deerfield River Basin or in towns with some portion falling within the basin. In the latter case, projects must be directly tied to the basin, e.g. a trail spur originating outside the basin that connects with a trail network within the basin.

Projects must provide clear public benefits and contribute to the goals of enhancing low impact recreational, environmental education, or environmental protection opportunities directly related to the Deerfield River Watershed.
Grant activities must take place after June 1, 2027 to be eligible for funding.
Under no circumstances should the project take longer than three years.

documents.quote: Upload a copy of your organization's budget to actual, including both revenue and expenses, from its current fiscal year.
Upload a copy of your organization's profit/loss statement and balance sheet from its most recently completed fiscal year.
If the project has a site-specific location, please upload a map with latitude/longitude points here.
Attach a copy of your estimated project budget.
